data.title: Palace Residences
data.about:
Welcome to Palace Beach Residence in Emaar Beachfront. A project that is coming soon! Offering 1 – 3 bedroom apartments with mesmerising views of the blue sea. 

The beachfront lifestyle awaits you here on a private island. This is the epitome of idyllic lifestyle. Register now to be part of the elite club in Dubai.
